notes.title: EARLY ACCESS PATCH#6 has been released!
notes.content:
[b]◆SYSTEMS[/b]
  - A new Ultimate Energy System has been added.
    Ultimate abilities now consume Ultimate Energy to activate.

  - The waves in each stage have been reduced, with only one boss appearing.

  - Bosses are now in an unstoppable state, making them immune to crowd control debuffs.

[b]◆ NEW SPELLS[/b]
 - SUMMON : MANA BOLT TURRET
   Summon the turret firing MANABOLT

 - TRANSCENDENCE
  MAX ULT ENERGY Increases to 5 

[b]◆ NEW ARTIFACTS[/b]
 - ANGEL STATUE
   6.5% Chance of STAMINA Recovery per sword Hits

 - STAR DUST
   14.5% Chance of MANABOLT Firing Per Rolling

 - GUARDIAN'S SHIELD
   Recovery 3% ULT ENERGY Per Rolling

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS PATCH#５ has been released!
notes.content:
[b]#Comment[/b]
 It took a lot of time to fix and fix a lot of things

 decided to remove the Castlecrawl stage and develop it with a focus on the survival stage
 We'll try to add various types of stages in the future

 It adds new content such as artifacts and Mana Bolt, ultimate system
 We've fixed various bugs and problems

 In the future, we will quickly add new content in the new system

 Thanks a lot.

[b]#SYSTEMS[/b]
 - Castle crawl stage has been removed.
 - The name has been changed to ｢Stamina｣.
 - The [Ultimate] tag has been added to the order.
 - The Artifact system has been added.
    The ability-related items are now added to the artifact inventory.
 - Additional [Exp], Additional [Gold] Stat has been added.
 - You can now get your Level Up rewards at the desired timing by pressing a button.
 - Now periodically fire the mana bolts.
    It can be strengthened with artifacts by having individual stat.
 - Active Item inventory has been reduced from 3 to 4 
 - The Passive Spell Slots has been expanded from 3 to 4

[b]◆ NEW SPELLS[/b]
 - CONCENTRATED MANA
    Gather energy to unleash a powerful magic projectile towards the target location
    Upon hitting an enemy, spell's cooldown will reset, and earn 15 MANA

[b]◆ NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
 - [ARTIFACT COLLECTOR]
    Earn 333 artifacts

[b]# BALANCE[/b]
 - For fine-grained balance adjustment,
    the number of ｢mana｣ related figures has increased significantly.
 - For detailed balance adjustment,
    the number of ｢stamina｣ related figures has increased significantly.
 - Now only certain powerful spells will have exhaustion count.
 - The enemy's physical strength increased in the second half of each stage.
 - The effect of [Bread] has been changed.
    New effect: Restores 100 HP, 3 STAMINA
 - The effect of [Milk] has been changed.
    New effect: Restores 125 HP, 4 STAMINA
 - The effect of [Meat] has been changed.
    New effect: Restores 150 HP, 5 STAMINA

    When you suffer damage leading to death, nullifies damage and grants invincibility

    Engages in a game that Determined by CRITICAL CHANCE
